newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN WANT TARNAT TO REPLACE ZIEGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN WANT TARNAT TO REPLACE ZIEGE.

text.p: Bayern Munich want to sign Karlsruhe's Michael Tarnat to replace wing-back Christian Ziege, who is expected to leave for AC Milan at the end of the season, German sports magazine Kicker reported on Thursday.

Kicker said Bayern manager Uli Hoeness had already made enquiries about Tarnat, who has earned a regular place in the German national squad through a string of fine performances with Karlsruhe in the first half of the season.
The 27-year-old left-sided player deputised for the injured Ziege in Germany's World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland in Nuremberg last November.
